name: Clay
positioning: GTM infrastructure for growth: data marketplace + Audiences data layer, Claygents/Account Agents, Workflows orchestration, and execution (sequencer/ads). Positions as AI growth engine / self-learning revenue engine for GTM engineers — not classic AI SDR or AI CRM.

Clay promoted the ranking on X Oct 15 (https://x.com/clay/status/2110736702394249696). recent.title: Sculpt: agent-first way to build in Clay (beta)
recent.summary: Outcome-based tasks; agent plans, runs and improves plays using Knowledge Hub (ICP, personas, positioning); recommends ICP updates from campaign results; schedules its own check-ins. Available to Sculpt attendees Oct 8; early-access users in coming weeks. No pricing announced. Showcase: https://sculpt.clay.com/showcase

recent.title: Sculpt: Clay Workflows in beta for all users; full launch this fall
recent.summary: Visual canvas where steps branch, loop, run code or call an agent; build from chat or a coding agent via CLI; per-run trace and bulk re-run; results write back to Audiences. Community post: available on Launch, Growth, Enterprise; legacy plans through year-end.

recent.title: Sculpt: Inbound SDR Agent preview (waitlist)
recent.summary: Clay's first agentic seller: enriches visitors, qualifies via voice, demos product in a sandbox, routes to rep calendars; trained on past demo call recordings. Pre-beta waitlist; no date or pricing. Puts Clay in the AI SDR lane (interpretation).

recent.title: Blog (SEO comparison): '10 ZoomInfo Alternatives for GTM Teams in 2026'
recent.summary: Oct 6 comparison post listed on clay.com/blog under More posts; competitive SEO content, not a launch. No Sculpt pre-announcement found as of Oct 7 morning. Sculpt agenda (sculpt.clay.com): 9:30 AM opening keynote by Kareem Amin with Abbie Kouzmanoff, Jeff Barg and Matthew Quan ('a first look at what Clay is building next'); Gunner Park on a self-learning revenue engine that fixes routing bugs via PR; closing fireside with Sierra co-founder Clay Bavor.

recent.title: Engineering: monty — internal Slack analytics agent (how-we-build)
recent.summary: Sep 30 engineering blog (also lists Sep 28): Clay built monty, an in-house Slack analytics agent over governed Snowflake/dbt models (Vercel eve + Opus). Internal tooling narrative — not a customer product launch.

recent.title: Clay Skills Marketplace launched
recent.summary: Sep 29 blog (+ Sep 30 X amplify): free community marketplace of GTM skills (playbooks) that install into Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor; Clay supplies data via Agent Plugin. Credits consumed when skills pull Clay data. Featured community creators; submission via skill-creator prompt.

recent.title: 24 new and updated marketplace integrations (EMEA/APAC, public sector, signals, Nooks sink)
recent.summary: Sep 29 blog by Karishma Rajaratnam: 24 new/updated providers — EMEA/APAC coverage, GovSpend/Pursuit public sector, Actovia CRE, Magellan PE hierarchy, G2/Sequel intent, action sinks including Nooks dialer, Canva, ClickHouse, Twain, HubSpot list. Available on every plan + free trial.

recent.title: 9 Ways to Use Clay's Agent Plugin to Build GTM Workflows and Tools
recent.summary: Clay Team blog Sep 23: nine internal builds on the Agent Plugin (API/CLI inside Claude Code/Codex). Plugin opened beta in July; generally available to every customer at no extra cost as of Sep 15, 2026.

recent.title: We asked 6,346 companies for a demo. Most never wrote back.
recent.summary: Thought-leadership Sep 22: Claygents filled thousands of B2B demo/contact forms and timed responses. Brand/content signal; no product ship.

recent.title: Series D: $115M at $7.1B valuation; 'AI growth engine' positioning
recent.summary: CEO Kareem Amin: Clay raised $115M Series D at $7.1B led by Wellington; participants include Sequoia, a16z perennial, Meritech, DST, CapitalG, others. Claims 4x revenue growth in 2025; 17k+ customers including 80% of Forbes AI50. Also announces $1M GTM Engineer scholarship. Teases launches at Sculpt conference.

recent.title: Account Agents in Workflows
recent.summary: Product announcement (Aug 25 / Aug 23 listed): drop Account Agents into Workflows so agents retain account memory and act inside plays.

recent.title: Workflows open beta — node-based GTM orchestration on Audiences
recent.summary: Introduces Workflows as orchestration layer on Audiences: triggers, branching, code nodes, Claygents, record-level observability/cost, unlimited steps/records. Open beta; free indefinitely on Launch/Growth/Enterprise.

recent.title: Account Research Agents open beta
recent.summary: Always-on agents reason over Audiences (CRM, Gong, email, warehouse, signals); synthesize fields and write back for expansion/re-engagement/health. Available on Enterprise, Growth, Launch.
